question: What credit amount did mission 1526 Training Day pay on the final live Tabula Rasa service?
result: Unresolved. The surviving final-week footage transcript reads 120 only partially; an older DaOpa/Ellatha mission listing was previously transcribed as 180. The corresponding original frame and exact archived Ellatha mission page are currently unavailable for independent reinspection. Neither the compatible client package nor an isolated run against this emulator contains independent final-live server reward data.

decision: Keep the 1526 credit amount explicitly unresolved. Do not promote either 120 or 180 to verified final-live data or modify the deployed seed on this evidence. The currently seeded 120 remains a labelled, partly observed reconstruction, subject to replacement if an original frame, final-live capture, or authoritative versioned server source establishes the amount.
next_evidence_needed: Recover or newly capture the original B2-023 reward frame at 98.400 seconds with enough resolution to read all digits, or obtain a versioned final-live Training Day offer/turn-in capture or server reward record.
